title: Kamishiro Rui — Backstage Alchemist〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Finally, we're back!
Home stage home!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were only gone a few days, but this stage is strangely comforting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The Beach Stage was really fun, but this is still the most wonderhoy stage of them all!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, I know that we're all very tired, but we should start putting away all our props and equipment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's get to it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There! That should be everything!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For the rest of the day, you're all to get some well-deserved rest!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You know, I wouldn't mind practicing a little right now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez, does your battery ever run out?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, we can't lose focus just because we're back at our home stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This assignment isn't over until we are all back home.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So make sure to look both ways when you reach a sidewalk, and double-check again before you cross!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're not little kids, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I will keep you safe, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Anyway, we'll see you tomorrow.
Shall we, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay.
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Yawn*... I'm getting sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Shall I carry you, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, but that would be way too embarrassing.

rows.Speaker: Child's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, a robot!

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: I know her! I saw her at Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Whoa, that's so cool! She looks just like you! Are you twins or something?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh, well...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
I was made to look just like Nene.
That is why we look so similar.

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Cool, it talked!
You can sing too, right? Please, just one song?

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
What are you still doing out?
I told you to come straight home!

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Aww...
You're still gonna keep doing shows, right?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Beep... Of course!
Please make sure to come and visit again.

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
I will!
I promise to go back! Bye!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Face-to-face conversations still aren't your thing, are they? Even though you improvised so well during our show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: B-Because it just happened so fast...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, Robo-Nene.
You really saved me just now.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: You're welcome, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now we're being recognized outside of the park and not just inside.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This never really happened before, did it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I feel like a lot of little kids are starting to recognize us more and more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, she's always been like a kid magnet. Once they spot her, they run right towards her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And their parents were usually there to stop them before anything happened.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, that seems pretty natural. Most people don't usually see robots walking around town.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But that's starting to change.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thanks to the shows we've been doing at the Wonder Stage, as well as Project Wonder, Robo-Nene herself has become a staple attraction.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Does that mean I have become a valued member of the Wonder Stage troupe?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, it does.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I hope your fame keeps growing moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Moving forward...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I started wondering about the future while I was talking to her. About us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I plan on figuring out what's truly best for me and what I really want to do on my own.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only are others viewing us differently, but we're also starting to see ourselves differently.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But she doesn't seem worried at all.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(She even said so herself.
We each need to figure out what's truly best for us.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still... The future, huh?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (For as long as I've known her, Nene's always respected my dreams.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And she may still have trouble interacting with strangers, she's doing her best to move forward.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (You've come such a long way, Nene.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (While I...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (No, I'm finally able to spread my wings as a director because I met Tsukasa and Emu and formed Wonderlands×Showtime with them...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We're making shows that make everyone smile.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I know that for a fact, but...)

rows.Speaker: Old Classmates
rows.Line: I'm not doing this just because you think it's fun!

rows.Speaker: Old Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah! What's wrong with you, Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui? Why are you sighing...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, it's nothing.
At least, that's what I'd like to say. I suppose I'm more exhausted than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. We did just come back from a pretty crazy trip. I might collapse on my bed when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure I can fall asleep in less than a second right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then let's go home and get in some well-deserved rest.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good.
